result: No remaining concrete source-level blocker found after requested setup-binding fixes. Runtime gates remain mandatory and unexecuted.
checks: Research HEAD must match GITHUB_SHA when supplied; exact experiment tree, workflow SHA256 and protocol Git blob are recorded before fixture acquisition.
All harness/workflow/protocol paths must be tracked and clean at the research HEAD; frozen runtime commit/tree, generated support, package lock and fixture/evidence identities are separately checked.
The unchanged fixed 36 fresh-child observations use all six ABC permutations twice, zero component warmups and no retry.

B selection, canonical raw reads, actual existing-latch compression/append, overlay construction and record sink are inside the endpoint. Both stores are finalized via allSettled inside the same primary clock.

All started workers are ultimately awaited in finally. Successful observations reject unexpected worker failures/exits and assert parent-resource plus filesystem lock/staging quiescence after worker termination.

Source/capture ownership hashes, complete decoded row/content checks, exact native B payloads and normalized A/C physical equality remain outside the clock. Reopened lookup probes are additional checks, not an exhaustive per-key query benchmark.

Fixed arithmetic requires both 10ms and 10% median paired savings, 9/12 faster blocks against each control, lower B equal-work totals, negative upper bootstrap interval endpoints in ms and percent, and the prescribed C/A drift bound.
The workflow pins checkout/setup-node/upload-artifact actions, disables persisted credentials, and always attempts both compact stdout reporting and complete/partial artifact retention.
The compact reporter exposes actual endpoint and group durations, identity/proof fields, worker and cleanup failures, and bounded failed-phase log tails, without fabricating absent values.
